fields.description: Azizi Ruby is an apartment development in Jumeirah Village Circle, with studios and one- to three-bedroom homes. Its residential layouts are paired with shared leisure facilities and retail space. The project’s published launch material and later portal guides use different commercial references, so a selected-unit quotation remains necessary.

reviewCoverage.identity: Azizi Ruby JVC identity confirmed from branded facts/launch flyer and Property Finder. Official own route and homepage returned 403/429; no security bypass attempted.
reviewCoverage.location: Branded factsheet says JVC; Property Finder District 15. Exact existing Jumeirah Village Circle mapping retained.
reviewCoverage.residences: Studio and one/two/three-bedroom apartments verified; no invented townhouse or villa category.
reviewCoverage.areas: Broker drawings for each of four bedroom families inspected visually; supplied drawings omit an area title block. Size bands therefore attributed to Property Finder, not independently measured or claimed as certified plans.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Branded launch flyer cinema, clubhouse, gym, pools and children’s play confirmed. Community facilities not substituted for building entitlements.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Branded historical flyer 617k differs from portal 618k; attributed portal guide retained, not live inventory.
reviewCoverage.payment: Flyer 50/50 shorthand versus portal 10/40/50 stages; no assumed dated developer calendar.
reviewCoverage.handover: Portal Q1/January 2028; other broker marketing Q4 2026 conflicts, not presented as current primary contract.
reviewCoverage.documents: Branded factsheet and launch flyer downloaded and rendered. Public Madena/Reelly file labelled floor plans is actually two repeated floorplate pages, not unit-area plans; excluded from floorPlanUrl. Official-host full pack and current price/payment documents unavailable.

overview: Studios and one- to three-bedroom apartments form the published residential collection. The neighbourhood address is Jumeirah Village Circle; any view or finish is specific to the selected residence.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Circle, District 15 according to Property Finder. Marketing access descriptions do not establish an existing on-site metro station.
research.priceLabel: Portal launch guide · reconfirm current quotation
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives AED 618,000. The older Azizi-branded launch flyer prints AED 617,000 and a 50/50 headline. These are different historical or advertised guides, not evidence of today’s available unit.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 10% booking, 40% construction and 50% handover, expanding the older flyer’s 50/50 headline. No current primary dated unit schedule was retrieved.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder forecasts Q1 2028, with January 2028 and a 23 January timeline. Some broker guides still quote Q4 2026. Obtain the current signed unit completion date; neither a delivered claim nor live construction percentage is adopted.
